part.text:
The fix is complete. 

**Root cause:** The upstream fix for this issue (redis/redis#11279) makes `USER_FLAG_SANITIZE_PAYLOAD` the default for newly created users, so that `ACL SETUSER ... reset` (which applies `sanitize-payload`) reverts the user to the exact state of a new user. In this refactored codebase, `ACLCreateUser` in `src/acl.c` was clearing the sanitize flags during initialization.

**Change:** `src/acl.c:444` — the flag-initialization loop in `ACLCreateUser` now sets `USER_FLAG_SANITIZE_PAYLOAD` instead of clearing it, matching the upstream behavior.

**Validation:**
- `./runtest --single unit/acl` — all tests pass (including the previously failing "ACL SETUSER RESET reverting to default newly created user" and "Validate subset of channels is prefixed with resetchannels flag")
- `./runtest --single unit/acl-v2` — all tests pass
